verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for a payments platform, but the pack documents no user-configurable automation or agent feature that runs on its own. Recurring subscription billing with automatic retries is a fixed payment feature, not a general automation capability. The MCP server, CLI and webhooks are developer building blocks that could be used to build automations, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
